transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I keep taking on more and more projects and plans at once, and I can’t seem to slow myself down even though everything in my life is starting to fall apart. It has just gotten completely out of hand and I don't know how to stop.
Have you struggled with these tendencies of taking on too much and being unable to slow down since childhood, or is this a recent, distinct change from your usual self?

No, this is definitely a recent change that started about three months ago after my illustration contracts were cancelled. Normally, I have a much calmer routine where I enjoy gardening, walking, and visiting museums, but this frantic spiraling only began when the financial stress hit.
Have you ever had periods in the past where you felt the opposite—very depressed, down, or lacking energy—or other times when you felt this same kind of intense energy?

No, I haven't really experienced periods of deep depression or this level of intense, out-of-control energy in the past. While I've had normal ups and downs, this current three-month stretch feels entirely different and much more extreme than anything I've gone through before.
During this high-energy period, have you experienced any unusual things, like hearing voices others can't hear, or having very strong beliefs that you have special powers or a unique mission?

I've never heard voices or anything like that, but I do feel like I'm operating at a special level where I can single-handedly redefine illustration education with my workshops. At the same time, I have this unshakable belief that the IRS and a former client are actively conspiring to sabotage my finances and force me into bankruptcy.
During these past three months, have you noticed a significantly decreased need for sleep, perhaps feeling fully rested and energized after only a few hours of sleep?

Honestly, I haven't really paid close attention to exactly how many hours of sleep I've been getting or whether I feel fully rested. My mind has just been too focused on all my projects and plans to really think about it.
Have you started any new medications, used recreational drugs, or significantly increased your alcohol intake since this high-energy period began?
No, I haven't started any new medications and I don't use recreational drugs. I also haven't increased my alcohol intake at all since this stressful period began.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with a three-month history of a first-episode manic state characterized by increased goal-directed activity, subjective inability to slow down, and significant functional impairment. The episode is accompanied by psychotic features, including grandiose delusions (believing they can single-handedly redefine illustration education) and persecutory delusions (believing the IRS and a former client are actively conspiring to sabotage their finances). There is no history of prior depressive or manic episodes, ruling out Bipolar Affective Disorder (F31) at this time, and substance-induced or organic causes have been ruled out.
